current_status_source: latest verified m6 operational preflight receipt

classification_legend.MACHINE_READY: Can be completed by repository code or a deterministic machine check without new private input.
classification_legend.USER_INPUT_REQUIRED: Needs a user-owned constraint, identity, acceptance, or private input.
classification_legend.USER_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED: Needs separate explicit authorization for a high-impact production action.
classification_legend.NATURAL_TIME_REQUIRED: Can only become true through elapsed real market sessions, events, or contemporaneous evidence.
classification_legend.RESEARCH_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Needs new external or research evidence, but not production authorization.

shadow_start_gate_legend.HARD_START_GATE: Must be satisfied before the first technical Shadow start.
shadow_start_gate_legend.SOFT_PRODUCT_GAP: Matters for product maturity but does not block technical Shadow start.
shadow_start_gate_legend.NATURAL_TIME_GATE: Must be satisfied after start by real elapsed time; it is not a pre-start precondition.
shadow_start_gate_legend.NOT_RELEVANT_TO_SHADOW_START: Does not gate technical Shadow start under the current long-term contract.

criteria.requirement: M3 Checkpoint B and strict contemporaneous-PIT product acceptance are complete.
criteria.current_state: M3 is PARTIAL and the strict contemporaneous PIT chain is not yet proven.
criteria.rationale: LONG-TERM-GOAL names completed M1-M5 product acceptance as an M6 prerequisite. The pre-start gate is the research evidence itself: a real contemporaneous decision chain that can only accrue over elapsed market time. NATURAL_TIME_GATE is reserved for post-start observation windows, so this criterion is classified as research evidence while keeping the elapsed-time dependency in its reopen condition.
criteria.reopen_condition: A real contemporaneous decision chain satisfies the strict PIT contract and M3 Checkpoint B is accepted.

criteria.requirement: M4 accepts one real, human-confirmed, reconciled private portfolio and IPS.
criteria.current_state: M4 personalized acceptance is WAITING_R2; only the private input contract and synthetic tests exist.
criteria.rationale: M6 product prerequisites and data requirements include an actual personal portfolio.
criteria.reopen_condition: The user imports, confirms, and reconciles an actual private portfolio and IPS.

criteria.requirement: M5 product acceptance for the authorized event scope is complete.
criteria.current_state: M5 remains PARTIAL and the bounded event product gate has not been accepted.
criteria.rationale: LONG-TERM-GOAL names completed M1-M5 product acceptance as an M6 prerequisite; this gate is scope-level, not symbol-specific.
criteria.reopen_condition: The M5 product event loop passes its acceptance criteria for the authorized scope.

criteria.requirement: A signed, artifact-bound production authorization receipt exists and matches the candidate deployment.
criteria.current_state: production_authorization_granted=false; all user_to_authorize values remain null.
criteria.rationale: The production authorization package is READY_FOR_USER_REVIEW_NOT_AUTHORIZED and explicitly says shadow_start_allowed=false.
criteria.reopen_condition: The user grants the scoped production authorization and the signed receipt verifies against exact artifacts.

criteria.requirement: The existing rootful systemd/rootful Podman runtime design is explicitly approved.
criteria.current_state: approve_host_and_existing_rootful_runtime_design=null.
criteria.rationale: Starting Shadow on the existing host is a high-impact production action.
criteria.reopen_condition: The user explicitly approves the host and runtime design scope.

criteria.requirement: Creation and cost of the private versioned Alibaba OSS backup bucket are explicitly approved.
criteria.current_state: approve_Alibaba_OSS_private_bucket_creation_and_cost=null.
criteria.rationale: The production authorization package makes offsite encrypted backup part of start readiness.
criteria.reopen_condition: The user approves the private bucket, retention policy, and cost boundary.

criteria.requirement: A real isolated restore on the production server is explicitly approved.
criteria.current_state: approve_real_isolated_restore_on_server=null; no production restore receipt exists.
criteria.rationale: The long-term contract requires isolated restore evidence before M6 operation and forbids using file existence as proof.
criteria.reopen_condition: The user authorizes the isolated restore window and a hash-bound restore passes RPO/RTO in a new database.

criteria.requirement: The systemd timer and local-outbox-only Shadow scope is explicitly approved.
criteria.current_state: approve_systemd_timer_and_local_outbox_shadow_scope=null.
criteria.rationale: Scheduler and notification scope are separately controlled production permissions.
criteria.reopen_condition: The user approves the exact timer, concurrency, failure budget, local outbox, and stop controls.

criteria.requirement: SSE/SZSE Shadow start is explicitly approved after every hard prerequisite passes.
criteria.current_state: approve_SSE_SZSE_shadow_start_after_all_preconditions=null.
criteria.rationale: The matrix records a future decision boundary; it does not request that decision now.
criteria.reopen_condition: The user separately approves Shadow start after all hard gates are independently verified.

criteria.requirement: The repository and privacy boundary audit is complete for the candidate revision.
criteria.current_state: The current preflight has not bound a complete candidate-revision repository/privacy audit.
criteria.rationale: Private data and secrets must remain outside Git and runtime publication before Shadow starts.
criteria.reopen_condition: A machine-run repository/privacy audit is hash-bound to the candidate revision and passes.

criteria.requirement: Backup, restore, and verifier code are bound to the candidate revision and its CI result.
criteria.current_state: The mechanism exists, but the current preflight lacks a candidate-bound CI restore receipt.
criteria.rationale: A real restore cannot be trusted unless the restore mechanism itself is reproducible and bound to the candidate.
criteria.reopen_condition: A candidate revision passes the CI restore-verifier suite and the result is bound to the preflight.

criteria.requirement: A real isolated restore passes the 24-hour RPO and 4-hour RTO targets.
criteria.current_state: No real production restore drill or measured RPO/RTO receipt exists.
criteria.rationale: LONG-TERM-GOAL requires independent encrypted backup and restore to a new database before operational acceptance.
criteria.reopen_condition: An authorized restore produces a verified manifest, dump, content fingerprint, and RPO/RTO receipt.

criteria.requirement: The official SSE/SZSE calendar scope is current and bound to the authorized Shadow venues.
criteria.current_state: Calendar artifacts are partial and no authorized venue-scope binding is complete.
criteria.rationale: Session counting must follow official completed exchange sessions and cannot use synthetic or self-declared dates.
criteria.reopen_condition: Current official calendar documents are verified and bound to the authorized SSE/SZSE start scope.

criteria.requirement: Authorized emergency stop and controlled restart drills pass.
criteria.current_state: The local stop contract exists, but production stop and restart drills have not run.
criteria.rationale: PTA protection and bounded restart are explicit long-term prerequisites.
criteria.reopen_condition: Authorized stop and restart receipts show only project timers/jobs were affected and PTA stayed healthy.

criteria.requirement: Current source, backup originals, and offsite copy are registered and verified.
criteria.current_state: No current production source backup manifest or verified offsite copy exists.
criteria.rationale: The production authorization package requires encrypted backup before Shadow operation.
criteria.reopen_condition: Authorized backup and offsite-copy receipts verify the candidate source and database.

criteria.requirement: A fresh read-only PTA baseline and database resource headroom pass.
criteria.current_state: The production PTA baseline and bounded resource observation are absent.
criteria.rationale: The start criteria require a fresh resource baseline and explicit PTA protection.
criteria.reopen_condition: The authorized read-only baseline passes and records memory, CPU, and PTA health.

criteria.requirement: Free disk exceeds the reserve plus estimated write volume.
criteria.current_state: No authorized disk check is bound to the Shadow candidate.
criteria.rationale: The production start criteria require a disk check with a 2 GiB reserve plus estimated writes.
criteria.reopen_condition: A fresh disk check exceeds reserve plus estimated write volume.

criteria.requirement: Authorized production health checks and failure classification are ready.
criteria.current_state: Production health observations are absent.
criteria.rationale: M6 requires health checks and source-failure degradation before real operation.
criteria.reopen_condition: Health checks are deployed under authorization and produce baseline receipts without PTA regression.

criteria.requirement: The authorized scheduler scope is deployed with single-instance locks and run receipts.
criteria.current_state: Production scheduler scope and run receipts are not authorized.
criteria.rationale: The timer schedule is part of the scoped production start.
criteria.reopen_condition: The approved scheduler runs once under lock and produces the expected no_order receipt.

criteria.requirement: All five signer keys are distinct and externally pinned.
criteria.current_state: The five external trust roots and signer identities are not established.
criteria.rationale: Operational admission requires four candidate signers and one distinct admission signer pinned outside the bundle.
criteria.reopen_condition: Five distinct externally pinned keys verify the authorization, candidate, intake, and admission roles.

criteria.requirement: External notification delivery is configured and observed.
criteria.current_state: Shadow deliberately uses a local outbox and no external delivery.
criteria.rationale: External delivery is a later product/operations capability, not a condition of technical Shadow start.
criteria.reopen_condition: A later scoped authorization defines delivery targets, severity, silence, acknowledgement, and retries.

criteria.requirement: Twenty consecutive real completed exchange sessions are observed in authorized Shadow.
criteria.current_state: Verified real Shadow sessions remain zero.
criteria.rationale: The long-term contract counts natural daily market sessions, not repeated execution, replay, or synthetic receipts.
criteria.reopen_condition: Twenty consecutive official completed sessions pass operational admission without a reset condition.

criteria.requirement: At least one real financial or capital-allocation event is observed and independently admitted.
criteria.current_state: No real-event operational observation exists.
criteria.rationale: The event must occur naturally and cannot be satisfied by historical replay or a synthetic receipt.
criteria.reopen_condition: A real event arrives during authorized Shadow and passes source, M5, session, and admission verification.

criteria.requirement: All M6 product, restore, authorization, natural-session, and event gates pass together.
criteria.current_state: M6_OPERATIONAL=NOT_STARTED and operational acceptance has not begun.
criteria.rationale: Operational acceptance is the post-start outcome of the complete observation window.
criteria.reopen_condition: Every M6 gate passes together and an independent review issues OPERATIONAL_ACCEPTANCE_PASSED.

criteria.requirement: The M7 product UX candidate and read model are ready for review.
criteria.current_state: M7 Product Read Model and five-page Excel candidate are READY_FOR_REVIEW; final user acceptance is still not passed.
criteria.rationale: M7 consumes M6 evidence; it must not delay the first technical Shadow start.
criteria.reopen_condition: The product read model and five-page UX candidate pass their own tests and review.

criteria.requirement: The user completes final M7 assisted-use acceptance.
criteria.current_state: Final user acceptance remains unreached.
criteria.rationale: M7 follows M6 and cannot gate Shadow start.
criteria.reopen_condition: After M6 operational acceptance, the user independently completes the defined workbench tasks.

criteria.requirement: 600519 scenario research leaves NEED_MORE_EVIDENCE.
criteria.current_state: 600519 remains NEED_MORE_EVIDENCE and STILL_NOT_READY.
criteria.rationale: The long-term M6 contract does not make one issuer's research status a system-wide Shadow start prerequisite.
criteria.reopen_condition: New external evidence reopens M5 only for the affected research object.

criteria.requirement: 600519 historical validation becomes PIT-safe or admitted.
criteria.current_state: 600519 historical validation is NOT_PIT_SAFE / NOT_ADMITTED and under EVIDENCE_STOP.
criteria.rationale: The historical stop rule forbids further evidence grinding and does not make this company case a technical Shadow gate.
criteria.reopen_condition: A newly available external source could materially change PIT admission; otherwise no work is opened.
